Metadata.CommitMsg:
Vision ready for the bank perimeter (#22)

The whole bank readiness plan (docs/security/bank-readiness-plan.md):
- Specs 040–045: UI-tree limits and SDK 1.0.0, Vision names, access per
  project, images by signature only, secrets at rest, corporate sign-in
  beside local accounts and a hardened API.
- Upgrades: Nest 12, Prisma 7, Node 24. Images pinned by digest, without
  root.
- Cut-over scripts with a guide (docs/guides/bank-cutover.md), and the
  export without history.
- Final audit: npm audit 0, permissive licenses only.

The running VRT is only read, as before.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
